# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 3 tokens; Text — 1 token; Fills and status backgrounds — 4 tokens; Borders and rings — 1 token; Palette ramps and brand — 39 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 16 tokens; Radius — 4 tokens; Shadow — 2 tokens; Layout — 9 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--paper, #fbf8f3);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--paper, #2d2317);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #fbf8f3;
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--paper` | #fbf8f3 | #2d2317 | Page background. Dark theme: the brown page background. |
| `--surface` | #ffffff | #3a2d20 | Cards, inputs, drawers sitting on paper. |
| `--surface-alt` | #f5efe6 | #4a3b2a | Alternate bands, image placeholder surface, table stripes. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 600 56px/60px Fraunces, 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: -0.02em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-display); letter-spacing: -0.02em;
font-family: var(--font-serif);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

## Spacing

4px base. space-n equals n times 4px.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (16)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Icon-to-label gap, hairline offsets. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Tight gaps inside chips. |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Gap between icon and text in buttons. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Default inner gap, input padding block. |
| `--space-5` | 20px | Card padding on mobile, gap between form fields. |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Button inline padding, small section gap. |
| `--space-7` | 28px | Card padding on desktop. |
| `--space-8` | 32px | Gap between cards on mobile. |
| `--space-9` | 36px | Gap between cards on desktop, heading to intro. |
| `--space-10` | 40px | Section inner gap on mobile. |
| `--space-11` | 44px | Block gap between stacked groups. |
| `--space-12` | 48px | Section padding on mobile. |
| `--space-13` | 52px | Gap between major blocks. |
| `--space-14` | 56px | Section padding on tablet. |
| `--space-15` | 60px | Large block spacing on desktop. |
| `--space-16` | 64px | Section padding on desktop (64px). |

## Shadow

Two elevation levels: flat (border only) and raised (soft shadow).

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--shadow-flat: none) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--shadow-flat), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--shadow-flat` | none | Elevation 0: card with a 1px line border, no shadow. |
| `--shadow-raised` | 0 4px 16px rgba(45,35,23,0.12) · dark: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.40) | Elevation 1: raised card, toast, drawer, floating WhatsApp. Soft and subtle only. |

## Layout

Container, gutters, breakpoints and minimum control sizes. Columns: 4 below 768, 8 from 768, 12 from 1024.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--container-max: 1200px) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--container-max), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (9)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--container-max` | 1200px | Container max width. |
| `--gutter-m` | 20px | Container side padding below 768px. |
| `--gutter-d` | 32px | Container side padding from 768px. |
| `--bp-sm` | 640px | Breakpoint: large phone. 4 columns below 768. |
| `--bp-md` | 768px | Breakpoint: tablet, 8 columns. |
| `--bp-lg` | 1024px | Breakpoint: small desktop, 12 columns. |
| `--bp-xl` | 1280px | Breakpoint: desktop. |
| `--control-height` | 48px | Minimum height of buttons and form controls. |
| `--tap-min` | 44px | Minimum tap target for icon buttons and links. |
